tagline: A desktop AI agent for business teams
brief: PP Agent is a desktop AI agent for people in finance, sales, operations and HR. It should feel approachable and trustworthy, a calm tool for non-developers that asks before it acts.
criteria: Success: recognisable at 32 px, distinct from the usual AI sparkle, works in one colour, and carries over from the current blue identity.

concepts.name: Growing Leaves
concepts.idea: Two layers of leaves grow around one core, getting larger toward the end of the turn: many inputs, one agent.
rationale: Leaves in two overlapping layers keep the radial feel of the current mark, with a clear direction of growth.
The translucent layers echo the product's layered panels, and the single bright core stands for the one agent.
A flat one-colour version and a bolder small-size cut keep it readable from 16 px to signage.

recommendation: Use the app-icon tile as the primary mark, the horizontal lockup in product and docs, and the flat one-colour or small-size cut wherever gradients or fine detail would break.
next_steps: Apply the icon set in the desktop, web and mobile apps
Run a trademark and reverse-image search
Confirm print colour values with a printer
